dataset_spec.name: mexico_covid
dataset_spec.description: Mexico SSA 2020 COVID-19 line-list (first 1000 confirmed cases). Binary death from age, sex, and named comorbidities.
dataset_spec.setting: Laboratory- or clinically-confirmed COVID-19 case reported to Mexico's national epidemiological surveillance system in 2020. The observations are age, sex, pregnancy, indigenous status, nationality, pneumonia at presentation and the chronic conditions recorded on the case-notification form; hospitalisation, intubation and intensive-care data are withheld.

covid_death.question: Based on this case-notification form, did this confirmed COVID-19 case die?
